about.en: MOO DENG on Ethereum is a community-run memecoin named after the viral pygmy hippo at Thailand's Khao Kheow Open Zoo. It is the ERC-20 token 0x28561b8a2360f463011c16b6cc0b0cbef8dbbcad (9 decimals), which venues list as MOODENGETH to tell it apart from the unrelated Solana memecoin Moo Deng (moo-deng); the two are separate tokens with separate prices.
